def fetch_new_articles(ledger: Ledger) -> list[dict]:
    """Freshly published posts from the content site's Atom feed that have
    never been featured before."""
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            FEED_URL, headers={"User-Agent": "already-here-digest/1.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
            root = ET.fromstring(r.read())  # noqa: S314 - our own Pages feed
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"feed fetch failed ({str(e)[:80]}) — no article section")
        return []
    ns = {"a": "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"}
    now = time.time()
    fresh = []
    for entry in root.findall("a:entry", ns):
        title = (entry.findtext("a:title", "", ns) or "").strip()
        link = entry.find("a:link[@rel='alternate']", ns)
        url = link.get("href") if link is not None else ""
        eid = entry.findtext("a:id", "", ns) or url
        published = entry.findtext("a:published", "", ns)[:10]
        try:
            age_days = (now - time.mktime(
                time.strptime(published, "%Y-%m-%d"))) / 86400
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if age_days > MAX_ARTICLE_AGE_DAYS:
            continue
        if not title or not url or ledger.seen(eid, title, url):
            continue
        fresh.append({"id": eid, "title": title, "url": url,
                      "published": published})
    return fresh

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Daily newsletter composer. Builds the digest from real pipeline data — the content site's Atom feed (today's freshly published article), trending_topics.json + youtube_uploads.json (video pipeline artifacts) and the live Gumroad catalog — then POSTs it to the runtime /newsletter/publish endpoint (Resend broadcast). A permanent content ledger (data/newsletter_ledger.json, committed by the workflow) records everything ever featured: id/url, semantic title fingerprint, kind, and date. Items already in the ledger are never featured again, matched by id/url AND by title-token similarity, so the same story under a different headline is still rejected. Hard publishing rule: no new source material = no issue. If nothing new is available (no new article, no unfeatured verified upload, no unfeatured trend), the send is SKIPPED (exit 0 with a warning) — repeat or unverifiable content is worse than a missed day. Env: RUNTIME_API_URL — required; Render runtime base URL GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN — optional; enables the rotating product spotlight OPENROUTER/GROQ/... — optional; free-LLM keys for the daily insight line Usage: python scripts/make_daily_digest.py [--dry-run] """ from __future__ import annotations import html import json import os import sys import time import urllib.parse import urllib.request import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET from pathlib import Path sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent)) from generate_shorts import ai_complete # noqa: E402 from youtube_publication import verified_youtube_uploads # noqa: E402 PAGES_BASE = "https://quantam101.github.io/content" BLUEPRINT_URL = f"{PAGES_BASE}/ebooks/blueprint/" EBOOK_URL = f"{PAGES_BASE}/ebooks/zero-dollar-content-engine/" FEED_URL = "https://www.alreadyherellc.com/content/feed.xml" LEDGER_PATH = Path("data/newsletter_ledger.json") MAX_ARTICLE_AGE_DAYS = 3 # a feed entry older than this is not "new today" SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.6 # Jaccard overlap of title tokens => same story _STOPWORDS = frozenset( "a an and are as at be by for from how in is it of on or the to that this " "these those with you your what why when where will can our we i".split()) def fingerprint(title: str) -> list[str]: """Semantic-ish fingerprint: sorted content tokens of the title.""" tokens = {t for t in "".join( c.lower() if c.isalnum() else " " for c in title).split() if len(t) > 2 and t not in _STOPWORDS} return sorted(tokens) def _similar(a: list[str], b: list[str]) -> bool: sa, sb = set(a), set(b) if not sa or not sb: return False return len(sa & sb) / len(sa | sb) >= SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD def _norm_url(url: str) -> str: """Canonical form for dedup: drop query/fragment and trailing slash.""" if not url: return "" p = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url) return f"{p.scheme.lower()}://{p.netloc.lower()}{p.path.rstrip('/')}" class Ledger: """Permanent record of every item ever featured in the digest.""" def __init__(self) -> None: self.entries: list[dict] = [] if LEDGER_PATH.exists(): # fail CLOSED: an unreadable permanent history must never be # treated as empty, or the next issue repeats old content and # the save overwrites the damaged file try: data = json.loads(LEDGER_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) self.entries = data["featured"] if not isinstance(self.entries, list): raise TypeError("'featured' is not a list") except Exception as e: print(f"::error::ledger {LEDGER_PATH} unreadable ({e}) — " "aborting so history is not lost; fix or restore the file") sys.exit(1) self._new: list[dict] = [] def seen(self, key: str, title: str = "", url: str = "") -> bool: fp = fingerprint(title) if title else [] nu = _norm_url(url) for e in self.entries: if key and key == e.get("key"): return True if nu and nu == _norm_url(e.get("url", "")): return True if fp and _similar(fp, e.get("fingerprint", [])): return True return False def add(self, kind: str, key: str, title: str, url: str) -> None: entry = {"kind": kind, "key": key, "title": title, "url": url, "fingerprint": fingerprint(title), "date": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.gmtime())} self.entries.append(entry) self._new.append(entry) def save(self) -> None: if not self._new: return LEDGER_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) LEDGER_PATH.write_text( json.dumps({"featured": self.entries}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8") print(f"ledger: recorded {len(self._new)} new item(s) " f"({len(self.entries)} total) -> {LEDGER_PATH}") def fetch_new_articles(ledger: Ledger) -> list[dict]: """Freshly published posts from the content site's Atom feed that have never been featured before.""" try: req = urllib.request.Request( FEED_URL, headers={"User-Agent": "already-here-digest/1.0"}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r: root = ET.fromstring(r.read()) # noqa: S314 - our own Pages feed except Exception as e: print(f"feed fetch failed ({str(e)[:80]}) — no article section") return [] ns = {"a": "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"} now = time.time() fresh = [] for entry in root.findall("a:entry", ns): title = (entry.findtext("a:title", "", ns) or "").strip() link = entry.find("a:link[@rel='alternate']", ns) url = link.get("href") if link is not None else "" eid = entry.findtext("a:id", "", ns) or url published = entry.findtext("a:published", "", ns)[:10] try: age_days = (now - time.mktime( time.strptime(published, "%Y-%m-%d"))) / 86400 except ValueError: continue if age_days > MAX_ARTICLE_AGE_DAYS: continue if not title or not url or ledger.seen(eid, title, url): continue fresh.append({"id": eid, "title": title, "url": url, "published": published}) return fresh def utm(url: str, campaign: str = "daily-digest") -> str: """Append UTM params to our own / partner links (not third-party YouTube).""" sep = "&" if "?" in url else "?" return (f"{url}{sep}utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email" f"&utm_campaign={urllib.parse.quote(campaign)}") def _load(name: str): p = Path(name) if p.exists(): try: return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) except Exception: pass return None def gumroad_products() -> list[dict]: """Live product list (name, short_url, price) from the Gumroad API.""" token = os.getenv("GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN", "").strip() if not token: return [] try: req = urllib.request.Request( f"https://api.gumroad.com/v2/products?access_token={token}", headers={"User-Agent": "already-here-digest/1.0"}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r: data = json.loads(r.read()) products = data.get("products", []) # missing "published" key must not hide live products (the public # product pages 200 even when the API omits the flag) live = [p for p in products if p.get("short_url") and p.get("published", True) is not False] print(f"gumroad: {len(live)}/{len(products)} products usable for spotlight") return live except Exception as e: print(f"gumroad fetch failed ({str(e)[:80]}) — skipping product spotlight") return [] def compose(ledger: Ledger) -> tuple[str, list[dict], str] | None: """Returns (headline, sections, cta_url), or None when there is nothing genuinely new to say (caller should skip the send).""" today = time.strftime("%B %d, %Y", time.gmtime()) manifest = {v["program"]: v for v in (_load("videos_manifest.json") or [])} # Selection reserves each accepted item in the ledger immediately, so # duplicates within the same batch (or across source categories) are # rejected too, not just items featured in past issues. articles = [] for a in fetch_new_articles(ledger): if len(articles) >= 3: break if ledger.seen(a["id"], a["title"], a["url"]): continue ledger.add("article", a["id"], a["title"], a["url"]) articles.append(a) raw_uploads = _load("youtube_uploads.json") or [] verified_uploads = verified_youtube_uploads(raw_uploads) raw_success_count = sum( 1 for u in raw_uploads if isinstance(u, dict) and u.get("status") == "success" ) suppressed = raw_success_count - len(verified_uploads) if suppressed > 0: print( f"youtube verification: suppressed {suppressed} artifact success " "record(s) that could not be independently verified public" ) uploads = [] for u in verified_uploads: if len(uploads) >= 5: break m = manifest.get(u.get("program", ""), {}) title = m.get("title") or u.get("verified_title") or u.get("program", "") url = u["url"] video_id = u["video_id"] if ledger.seen(video_id, title, url): continue # Only proven-accessible uploads are allowed into the permanent ledger. ledger.add("upload", video_id, title, url) uploads.append(u) trending = [] for t in (_load("trending_topics.json") or []): if len(trending) >= 3: break key = t.get("id", "") or t.get("url", "") if ledger.seen(key, t.get("title", ""), t.get("url", "")): continue ledger.add("trend", key, t.get("title", ""), t.get("url", "")) trending.append(t) # Hard publishing rule: no new source material = no issue. Product # spotlight and AI insight alone never justify a send. if not (articles or uploads or trending): return None products = gumroad_products() sections: list[dict] = [] if articles: items = [] for a in articles: link = html.escape(utm(a["url"], "daily-digest-article"), quote=True) items.append(f'• ' f'{html.escape(a["title"])}') sections.append({"heading": "New today", "body": ("Freshly published on our site:
" + "
".join(items))}) insight = ai_complete( "Write a 2-3 sentence practical daily insight for small-business " "owners about automating content, lead capture, or customer service " "with free AI tools. Concrete and specific, plain text, no emojis, " "no hashtags.", min_len=60, max_len=500) if insight: sections.append({"heading": "Today's automation insight", "body": html.escape(insight)}) if uploads: items = [] for u in uploads: m = manifest.get(u.get("program", ""), {}) raw_title = ( m.get("title") or u.get("verified_title") or u.get("program", "Verified video") ) url = u["url"] items.append(f'• ' f'{html.escape(raw_title)}') sections.append({"heading": "Verified on our channel", "body": "
".join(items)}) if trending: items = [] for t in trending: raw_title = t.get("title", "") url = t.get("url", "") vpd = t.get("views_per_day") stat = f" — ~{vpd:,} views/day" if vpd else "" items.append(f'• ' f'{html.escape(raw_title[:80])}{stat}') sections.append({ "heading": "What's pulling views right now", "body": ("Top performers in our niches, live from today's " "trend scan:
" + "
".join(items))}) cta_url = utm(BLUEPRINT_URL) if products: # rotate the spotlight daily so no two consecutive issues match pick = products[int(time.strftime("%j")) % len(products)] name = html.escape(pick.get("name", "")) price = pick.get("formatted_price") or "" link = utm(pick["short_url"], campaign="daily-digest-product") sections.append({ "heading": "From our toolkit", "body": (f'{name}' f'{f" — {html.escape(str(price))}" if price else ""}. ' f'Built from the same automation stack that writes this ' f'email. The full build manual is in ' f'the Complete Blueprint, ' f'and the free intro is ' f'The $0 Content Engine.')}) headline = f"AI Income Digest — {today}" return headline, sections[:10], cta_url def publish(headline: str, sections: list[dict], cta_url: str) -> dict: base = os.environ["RUNTIME_API_URL"].rstrip("/") payload = {"headline": headline, "sections": sections, "tags": ["ai", "automation", "already-here"], "cta_url": cta_url} req = urllib.request.Request( f"{base}/newsletter/publish", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "already-here-digest/1.0"}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r: return json.loads(r.read()) def main() -> None: ledger = Ledger() composed = compose(ledger) if not composed: print("::warning::no NEW source material (article/verified uploads/trends all " "already featured or empty) — skipping today's send to avoid " "repeat or unverifiable content") return headline, sections, cta_url = composed print(f"headline: {headline}") for s in sections: print(f" section: {s['heading']}") if "--dry-run" in sys.argv: Path("daily_digest_preview.json").write_text( json.dumps({"headline": headline, "sections": sections, "cta_url": cta_url}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8") print("dry run — wrote daily_digest_preview.json, nothing sent " "(ledger not updated)") return result = publish(headline, sections, cta_url) print(json.dumps(result)) if not result.get("ok"): print(f"::error::newsletter publish failed: {result.get('error')}") sys.exit(1) ledger.save() if __name__ == "__main__": main()
